Bound requests/responses, frames, bytes and total elapsed time; absent/invalid ownership, source, identity, protocol or evidence fail closed.

After closure, same exact daemon, unchanged completed root turn and unchanged Goal usage must bracket full local wait coverage and match the original native trace. Missing or changed evidence remains UNKNOWN; late native activity still invalidates zero-call claims.

Existing controller CLI now accepts --wait-platform-handoff SECONDS (1..600), holding the writer lock and waiting in ordinary Python. STOP, permanent RPC errors and timeout fail closed; expired attempts cannot reset their deadline.
The gate never pauses the platform Goal. Actual root is still active, so this is not a deployment or production wait proof.
